recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5279 unless a future work group decision changes ServiceRequest or request-resource wording more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-5279 was a Published/Persuasive January 2015 OO ballot comment against the FHIR core clinical table of contents. It asked that the Diagnostic Order entry change from "A request for a diagnostic investigation service to be performed" to "A record of a request for a diagnostic investigation service to be performed" to avoid contradicting the DiagnosticOrder scope text.
initial_application: Git commit d6259fa8e3 applied the DSTU-era change in source/diagnosticorder/diagnosticorder-spreadsheet.xml by changing the DiagnosticOrder long definition to "A record of a request for a diagnostic investigation service to be performed" and tagging the row with [#5279].
additional_context: DiagnosticOrder is no longer an active current-build resource. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active, lists DiagnosticOrder and DiagnosticRequest under removed resources, and records that DiagnosticOrder was subsumed into ServiceRequest. Later Published issues FHIR-10295 and FHIR-11119 renamed DiagnosticOrder to DiagnosticRequest and then merged DiagnosticRequest with ProcedureRequest. The current ServiceRequest StructureDefinition retains the "record of a request" semantics and carries committee notes including [#5279][#11119].
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The historical requested wording was applied, and current active source already conveys the corrected semantics through ServiceRequest while the original DiagnosticOrder page is out of build scope.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published ballot comment for the DiagnosticOrder resource page asks for the same record-of-request wording and resolves by reference to FHIR-5279.

Published OO/PC decision merged DiagnosticRequest with ProcedureRequest, leading to the current ServiceRequest successor source.
